_about: Graphics tiers (S-20). Graphics.gd picks one at boot from the GPU (Intel integrated / software / unknown = low; NVIDIA or AMD discrete = high); --graphics=low|high overrides. high is empty on purpose: it changes nothing, so it is exactly today's look (the GTX 1060). The Hill is 2D: the 3D keys only reach the lobby's 3D character slots; max_lights and particle_scale are the 2D costs.
